rationale:
Issue #106 ('Renaming ConnectionTypes isn't working') reports that when a Type has a field returning Connection<MessageObject> and the ConnectionType is renamed via `as:`, schema construction fails with 'Type "MessageObjectConnection" was referenced but not defined', or the unrenamed name leaks into the schema. The minimized production patch is a single hunk in Sources/Graphiti/Component/Component.swift that only moves .connection ahead of .type in the ComponentType processing priority (.connection 8->5, .type/.types/.union shifted to 6/7/8), which directly addresses that ordering-dependent resolution failure; PR #109 and the commit message state exactly this intent. Traceability is fix_commit -> merged PR #109 -> issue #106, matching the verified issue key. The patch touches no other file, adds no enum cases, signatures, features, docs, or configuration, and contains no formatting or refactor noise; retained_hunks=[1] with removed_hunk_count=0 and post_minimization_validation PASS. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test appended to the pre-existing Tests/GraphitiTests/ConnectionTests.swift and reproduces the reported scenario literally (Type(ChatObject.self, as: "Chat") with a Connection field, Type(MessageObject.self, as: "Message"), ConnectionType(MessageObject.self, as: "Message")). It relies only on APIs already present at the buggy parent revision, which is confirmed by strict evidence: build.both_versions passed and testNaming fails on the buggy revision in isolation and in the full suite while all fixed runs are green over 3 repetitions and 32 matrix runs, so the test compiles and runs pre-fix rather than depending on any API introduced by the fix. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this component-ordering root cause duplicates no active registry entry.

Issue #106 ('Renaming ConnectionTypes isn't working') reports that with Type(ChatObject.self, as: "Chat") holding a Connection<MessageObject> field plus ConnectionType(MessageObject.self, as: "Message"), schema construction fails with 'Type "MessageObjectConnection" was referenced but not defined', or the renamed connection name is ignored. The minimized production patch is a single hunk in Sources/Graphiti/Component/Component.swift that only moves .connection ahead of .type in the ComponentType ordering (.connection 8->5, .type/.types/.union shift to 6/7/8), which is exactly the mechanism described in commit message and PR #109 ('orders Connection in front of Type, which avoids errors when types have a field with a Connection object'). No signatures, cases, APIs, formatting-only, docs, or config changes are present; original_hunk_count=1, retained=1, removed=0. The trigger is the unchanged upstream test testNaming appended to the pre-existing Tests/GraphitiTests/ConnectionTests.swift and mirrors the issue's reproduction snippet almost verbatim; it uses only Type(as:), ConnectionType(as:), Connection<MessageObject>, PaginationArguments, and Array.connection(from:), all of which exist at the buggy parent b17c86b since the fix touches only enum ordinals and adds no API. Strict machine evidence supports the differential: build.both_versions passed, trigger.buggy_differential reproduced ConnectionTests.swift::testNaming, trigger.fixed_clean and full_suite.fixed_all_green passed, full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers passed, and trigger.deterministic gave 3 matching fingerprint groups over 3 repetitions with a complete 32-run matrix; the same gate set passed post-minimization. Traceability is fix_commit -> merged PR #109 -> issue #106, and #106 is the sole allowed verified root cause key. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no active registry entry.
